CODE_PURPLE.label: CODE PURPLE
CODE_PURPLE.meaning: Acute mode: repo or root under an open Code Purple case or a P0 control-plane red (E1/E2).

CROSSWALK.label: CROSSWALK
CROSSWALK.meaning: Identity join between SHA, OID and function, or a declared cross-model edge.

EVERRED.label: EVERRED
EVERRED.meaning: Never green in the traced history, or an open EVERRED root.

FAIL.label: FAIL
FAIL.meaning: Observed FAIL that is not ranked as a source red.

ISSUE_BD.label: ISSUE / BD
ISSUE_BD.meaning: Burn-down queue item or open issue/PR load.

NEUTRAL.label: SOURCE / SINK
NEUTRAL.meaning: Supplier, input or customer without its own status.

PASS.label: PASS
PASS.meaning: Verified PASS on an exact SHA.

P_PROCESS.label: P-PROCESS
P_PROCESS.meaning: Step of the P-process EVERRED loop.

ROOT_RED.label: FIRST RED / ROOT RED
ROOT_RED.meaning: SOURCE_RED FAIL gate (ranked by what it unlocks) or the first red commit that opened a workflow break window.

UNKNOWN.label: UNKNOWN
UNKNOWN.meaning: Not observed or not qualified. Never PASS.

metric_definitions.blocked_by_ancestor: Non-PASS gate instances with at least one non-PASS prerequisite: cannot be qualified yet.
metric_definitions.census_sha_drift: Focus repos whose census HEAD differs from the FOCUS5 gate SHA: their census OIDs describe a newer tree than the gate evidence.
metric_definitions.critical_path: Longest prerequisite chain in the gate DAG; pass_depth = consecutive PASS gates from the start of that chain.
metric_definitions.deploy_contract_core: Deploy jobs passing the core deploy contract (DP1-DP10) / deploy jobs found.
metric_definitions.lifecycle_median_level: Median S0..S9 census level per stage over the 21-repo roster (L0 ABSENT .. L5 CONTROLLED, cumulative ladder).
metric_definitions.measurement_debt_pct: UNKNOWN gate instances / all gate instances. UNKNOWN is never PASS.
metric_definitions.oid_coverage: Nodes bound to at least one git blob OID / all nodes.
metric_definitions.phase_yield: PASS / gate instances inside one DMAIC phase (first-pass yield on the exact SHA).
metric_definitions.ready_frontier: Gate instances whose prerequisites are all PASS but which are not PASS themselves: work that can start now.
metric_definitions.red_now_median_age_days: Median age in days of currently red workflows (first red to observation).
metric_definitions.rolled_throughput_yield: Product of the phase yields: probability a repo passes every phase on one SHA.
metric_definitions.sha_coverage: Nodes bound to at least one 40-hex commit SHA or sha256 digest / all nodes.
metric_definitions.unguarded_test_job_pct: CI test jobs without a zero-test guard / CI test jobs.
metric_definitions.untested_module_pct: Python modules with no referencing test / python modules.
